title: Edge browsing history
whyItMatters: Lists every page visited, when and what was searched. For a work or school PC it also exposes employer and internal site names.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include History (Edge uses this layout): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One History file per profile. Looked for on this PC: exists.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export your favorites from Edge if you want to keep the sites you saved.
steps: In Edge, open Settings > Privacy, search, and services and clear browsing history.
Delete the history file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local Edge history for every profile on this PC; with sync on, history can come back from the Microsoft account.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, View and delete browser history in Microsoft Edge: https://support.microsoft.com/en-US/edge/view-and-delete-browser-history-in-microsoft-edge
